function_signature: def tmr_voter(a: bytes, b: bytes, c: bytes) -> bytes
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (10 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
source: TMR practice in aerospace electronics standards
author: Liang Jing
constraints: The three inputs have the same length, or ValueError

bit-wise 2-of-3 majority voting: majority = (a & b) | (a & c) | (b & c). When at least two of the three bytes are equal this formula agrees exactly with "take the byte value occurring ≥2 times"; when all three differ pairwise, this formula governs (giving a composite byte equal to none of the inputs)
a constant-time implementation (no if/else branch selecting on a secret value)
